{{Top|leg|title=''Rimrunner'' group}}
The '''''Rimrunner'' group''' was a group of [[BFF-1 bulk freighter/Legends|BFF-1 bulk freighters]] working for the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. It was destroyed by Imperial forces during their attack on [[Organarms]].

==Behind the scenes==
The group's name is spelled "Rimmrunner" in [[Star Wars: TIE Fighter (video game)|''Star Wars: TIE Fighter'']] and "Rim Runner" in ''[[TIE Fighter Collector's CD-ROM: The Official Strategy Guide]]''.
